item.name: OPPO A6 A6X A6T Premium Leather Wallet Flip Case
item.title: OPPO A6 A6X A6T Premium Leather Wallet Flip Case
item.description:
🌟 Premium Leather Wallet Flip Case – Slim & Stylish Protection 🌟
Upgrade your phone with our Premium Leather Wallet Flip Case, combining sleek design with practical functionality. Crafted from genuine leather, this flip case offers a luxurious feel while keeping your device secure.
🔹Key Features:
✅ Dual Card Slots + Extra Front Slot – Conveniently store up to 2 cards in the dedicated slots and use the additional front slot for quick access to essentials like IDs or transit cards.
✅ Premium Leather Build – Soft, durable leather ensures long-lasting protection and a sophisticated look.
✅ Secure Magnetic Closure – Keeps your phone and cards safely in place while on the go.
✅ Precise Cutouts – Easy access to buttons, ports, and camera without removing the case.
✅ Slim & Lightweight – Adds minimal bulk while providing full coverage for your phone.
Ideal for everyday use, this wallet flip case keeps your cards and cash organized while offering reliable phone protection. Perfect for those who value style, convenience, and functionality in one sleek accessory.

🌟 Sarung Flip Dompet Kulium Premium – Perlindungan Stylish & Ringkas 🌟
Tingkatkan telefon anda dengan Sarung Flip Dompet Kulium Premium kami, yang menggabungkan reka bentuk elegan dengan fungsi praktikal. Dibuat daripada kulit asli, sarung flip ini memberikan rasa mewah sambil melindungi peranti anda.
🔹Ciri-Ciri Utama:
✅ 2 Slot Kad + 1 Slot Tambahan di Hadapan – Mudah simpan sehingga 2 kad dalam slot khusus dan gunakan slot tambahan di hadapan untuk akses pantas ke kad ID atau kad transit.
✅ Binaan Kulium Premium – Kulit lembut dan tahan lasak memberikan perlindungan jangka panjang dan penampilan yang bergaya.
✅ Penutup Magnet Selamat – Memastikan telefon dan kad anda tetap di tempat semasa dalam perjalanan.
✅ Potongan Tepat – Akses mudah ke butang, port, dan kamera tanpa perlu tanggalkan sarung.
✅ Ringkas & Ringan – Tidak menambah berat tetapi tetap memberikan perlindungan penuh.
Sesuai untuk kegunaan harian, sarung flip dompet ini membantu anda mengurus kad dan wang tunai dengan kemas sambil melindungi telefon. Pilihan terbaik untuk mereka yang mengutamakan gaya, kemudahan, dan fungsi dalam satu aksesori.

🌟 优质皮革翻盖钱包手机壳 – 轻薄时尚，安全防护 🌟
为您的手机升级这款优质皮革翻盖钱包手机壳，融合时尚设计与实用功能。采用真皮材质，手感奢华，同时为手机提供全面保护。
✅主要特点:
✅ 双卡位 + 前置额外卡槽 – 内置2个专用卡位，前置额外卡槽方便快速取用身份证或交通卡。
✅ 优质皮革材质 – 柔软耐用的皮革，提供长久保护，彰显高端质感。
✅ 安全磁吸扣 – 牢固闭合，确保手机和卡片在移动中不会滑落。
✅ 精准开孔 – 轻松操作按键、接口和摄像头，无需拆卸手机壳。
✅ 轻薄设计 – 不增加厚重感，同时提供全面防护。
适合日常使用，这款翻盖钱包手机壳让您的卡片和现金整齐收纳，同时为手机提供可靠保护。完美适合追求时尚、便利与多功能一体的人士。

services.title: 15-Day Free Returns
services.description: Request for a free return within 15 days and get a full refund*. Applicable to selected items. Electronic Category products must remain SEALED (i.e., the seal is not broken, been tampered with, or altered). Exclusion Applied. View T&C here.

services.title: Cash on Delivery
services.description: 1. Shopee offers Cash On Delivery (COD) in Malaysia for Doorstep Delivery or orders under RM500.  2. You order will be assigned to Shopee Supported Logistics partners for delivery.  3. Pay cash to the courier upon parcel delivery.  4. Do note that the amount payable will be rounded to the nearest 5 cents.  5. A reminder to beware of fraudulent behaviors, you do not need to make any payments directly to seller for Cash On Delivery orders.
